Name: CoCo 3 GIME 16-colour game (template)

VisualLanguage.rendering: flat colour cartoon with a dark outline and one shade step per colour

rules: Each colour is one flat area. Shade with the darker colour of the same family, never with a gradient.

LineAndShape.outline: black, at least one target pixel thick

BackgroundPolicy.default: the Target background colour, or transparent for sprites

TypographyPolicy.default: No words, letters, numbers or pseudo-text.

CompositionPolicy.screen: A full playfield or scene that fills the frame.
CompositionPolicy.background: Scenery only, no characters, with open space where sprites will move.
CompositionPolicy.sprite: One subject, centred, full body, with even padding on all sides.
CompositionPolicy.sprite-sheet: One subject in each cell, the same scale and baseline in every cell, no overlap.
CompositionPolicy.tile: A pattern that repeats at its left, right, top and bottom edges.
CompositionPolicy.tile-set: One tile in each cell, each tile filling its cell edge to edge.
CompositionPolicy.title: A title picture with no lettering; leave a clear band where the program draws the name.
CompositionPolicy.icon: One simple object, centred, readable at a very small size.
CompositionPolicy.concept: A mood picture for discussion; not converted.

QualityRules: The subject reads clearly as a silhouette.
No detail smaller than the minimum feature size.
